intro: From April to June 2026, ZCyberNews published 53 articles on ransomware, with The Gentlemen, LockBit, and ShinyHunters among the most frequently observed threat actors. Key vulnerabilities exploited included CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. The healthcare, manufacturing, education, and technology sectors were heavily impacted, with reports spanning North America, the United States, Europe, and Turkey. Coverage comprised 40 high-severity, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational incidents.
